capabilities: Generate AI Briefs that analyze a folder (topic clusters, knowledge map, suggested prompts)
Generate AI MOCs by following wikilinks from a Brief or note
Export Context Packs as clean Markdown bundles for ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, NotebookLM, and Claude Code
Create Knowledge Books as EPUB with cover and table of contents
Export workspaces as Notion-ready ZIPs with converted Obsidian syntax
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It is part of the 'Dualyze Ecosystem' of tools, and the README offers downloadable English and Japanese sample vaults plus an external tutorial.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to bundle, analyze, and repackage vault folders into formats AI assistants, e-readers, or Notion can consume.

relations.evidence: Export an entire workspace as a Notion-ready ZIP. Import it into Notion

summary: Turns folders of notes into AI Briefs, AI MOCs, Context Packs, EPUB Knowledge Books, and Notion-ready workspace ZIPs.
